items.title: Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: we played this battle of the bands with Erskine Hawkins

ctx.x: The YMCA has this wire and it was a wire from Jimmie Lunceford. Said would you like to join my band? If you would like to join my band call this number. So we were waiting to play a date, we were going to battle Erskine Hawkins. We were going to put Snooky on Erskine by the way. We had him all ready to be chewed up by Snooky.
He makes no bones about it.
